text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby concludes. Admire Vega 
was far out of reach... Meisho Doto simply 
couldn't match her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, she didn't even have the luxury to 
enjoy the memorial race. But she wished 
that someday, she would be able to enjoy 
it with a smile.
